item.description: GitHub Repo :- https://github.com/sahaavi/New-Venture-s-Compass Dashboard Video :- https://youtu.be/bs5oX2mORGQ?si=27KLoOi4sf7ECzaq Project Description The app contains a landing page that gives descriptive information on data sources used and the different development indicators from Worldbank project whose purpose is to assess business environment in different countries.
